organisation.title: Review requests and match
organisation.text: See new requests, suggest suitable peers and approve matches.

organisation.title: Overview of peers and members
organisation.text: Who is active, who is waiting for a match? All in one place.

organisation.title: Confidential exchange
organisation.text: Messages only reach your own match. Members can use a pseudonym.

organisation.title: Measure impact
organisation.text: Key figures and surveys for your reports and funders.

organisation.title: In your branding
organisation.text: Your own logo, colours and address. Multilingual for national programmes.

nutzerin.title: Easy to get started
nutzerin.text: Register and describe your situation in a short questionnaire. Anonymously or under a pseudonym.

nutzerin.title: The right peer
nutzerin.text: A professional from the organisation reviews the request and connects you with someone who has had a similar experience.

nutzerin.title: Exchange at your own pace
nutzerin.text: Confidentially in the platform chat, with email notifications. Later, if you like, also by phone, video or in person.

nutzerin.title: Help when more is needed
nutzerin.text: For complex issues, the path leads to your organisation’s professional counselling.

aufgaben.title: Operation and hosting
aufgaben.text: We host the platform with an ISO 27001-certified provider in Switzerland and make sure it runs reliably. The data never leaves Switzerland and the EU.

aufgaben.title: Maintenance and development
aufgaben.text: Updates, security and new features come from us continuously, with no effort on your part.

aufgaben.title: Data protection
aufgaben.text: In line with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP). Members decide for themselves what they share and can remain anonymous.

aufgaben.title: Your branding
aufgaben.text: Your logo, your colours, your address. For national programmes, we implement the platform in several languages.
